scientific_limitations: Only the fixed Pauli X/Y/Z triple of qubit measurements under zero-temperature amplitude damping is classified; not the channel-wide n-incompatibility-breaking property. Broad zonoid compatibility results could imply a differently parametrized equivalent.
title: Exact pairwise and triplewise compatibility thresholds for the amplitude-damped Pauli triad
